The first versioned release of the portfolio, and the moment it stopped being a site
without a release process.

- **Package manager migrated from Bun to npm.** `package-lock.json` is now the source of
  truth for the dependency tree, and CI, Pages deploy, dependency guard and Dependabot
  all install from it with `npm ci`.
- **Node 24 is the project baseline**, declared in `.nvmrc`, `package.json#engines` and
  every workflow. Until now the repository declared no Node version at all, which left
  room for an environment to fall onto Node 20 — end of life, no patches.
- **The release cycle is validated by `release-core`**, web archetype, with **no
  distribution artifact**: the site is a static build, and its output belongs to the
  Pages deploy, not to a release asset.
- **Release and deploy are separate.** A `vX.Y.Z` tag produces this release; a push to
  `main` publishes the site.
- Stack: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Tailwind CSS v4, i18next.
- Homepage localized in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
- Live at https://mafhper.github.io/
